questions.prompt: How many total hours of original video content are stored on professional cinema movie reels for all feature films released globally in a single year?
reasoning: Around 6,000 feature films are released worldwide each year across various languages and countries.
The average runtime of a feature film is about 1.5 to 2 hours, meaning roughly 10,000 hours of unique theatrical content.
Accounting for multiple reels, archival backup master prints, and distribution copies made for thousands of screens globally, total hours of film prints reach about 450,000 hours.

questions.prompt: How many total grams of sea salt are produced annually by all commercial salt evaporation ponds operating in Australia?
reasoning: Australia produces approximately 12 million tonnes of salt per year primarily through solar evaporation.
One tonne is equal to one million grams.
Multiplying 12 million tonnes by 1,000,000 grams per tonne yields 12 billion grams.

questions.prompt: How many total individual petals are there across all flowers blooming simultaneously in a typical large botanical garden during peak spring season?
reasoning: A large botanical garden might contain around 500,000 individual flowering plants in peak bloom.
Each plant, whether a flower bed annual, shrub, or bulb, averages about 100 individual petals across its blooms.
Multiplying 500,000 plants by 100 petals per plant gives 50 million petals.
